method: Passive recorded-state accounting plus independent source calls on recorded observations for behavioral identity. No game engine imported, state advanced, simulation or counterfactual continuation run.

zero_net_wheat_pair.interpretation: The two recorded sell/buy rounds have zero combined cash gain, with starting wheat stock restored. This does not attribute all wheat trading elsewhere in the game.

own_strawberry_bonus_audit.qualification: Reference quotes at recorded refresh deadlines, not a counterfactual profit estimate. Extra routing, effective coverage duration, capacity and market impact are unresolved. Fertilizer carried elsewhere is not necessarily reachable in time.

limitations: Behavioral match to Cycle 15 does not independently reveal uploaded file bytes or identify opponent code.
Product receipts are the cash-accounting residual after subtracting wheat/fertilizer purchases, not gross revenue by product.
Market orders are requests unless separately reconciled; requested animal purchases materially exceed accepted purchases in this game.
Harvested output is not automatically delivered or sold output. The six night harvest adjustments were inspected against tile actions and refresh rules.
Peak asset types can occur at different times; occupied crop tiles include immature plants.
Both private inventories support retrospective accounting; a live policy may only use its own private inventory and public rival farm.
One selected loss cannot establish rating performance or prove the profit of an alternative policy. Cycle 17 remains unevaluated by this replay.
